title: A cooling stellar remnant
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: A white dwarf is the exposed compact core left after a low- or intermediate-mass star sheds its outer layers. It gradually cools over a very long time.

misconception: A learner may choose: A newly formed galaxy
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What is a white dwarf?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What is a white dwarf? The compact remnant core of a star such as the Sun after outer layers are shed. A white dwarf is the exposed compact core left after a low- or intermediate-mass star sheds its outer layers. It gradually cools over a very long time.
Visual caption: A compact cooling core. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
